name: por_usv_gate
_comment: Proof of Readiness — USV autonomous navigation demonstration (Handbook 3.1.2). SUBMISSION DEADLINE 31 AUGUST 2026. Two gates of red/green markers; the USV starts 3 m behind gate 1 and transits both. Handbook permits any red/green markers ~1 m above the waterline; it references Taylor Made Sur-Mark 950410 (red/port) and 950400 (green/starboard), 0.99 m above waterline, 46 cm diameter -> 0.23 m radius. Origin is San Diego to match the other scenarios; see tools/sim/venue_check.py before the venue migration.
